description: This script automates the generation of documentation for plugins by processing changed files, validating JSON outputs, calling external scripts for documentation generation from headers and JSONs, and updating documentation files and sidebar. It is part of an automated documentation workflow in a larger project.

methods.name: get_plugin_from_path(file_path)
methods.description: Extracts the plugin name from a given file path based on directory structure patterns.

methods.name: validate_json_changes(changed_files)
methods.description: Checks if JSON changes in the 'apis/' directory have corresponding output files in the 'tools/md_generator/json/' directory. Returns validation status and list of missing plugins.

methods.name: get_plugins_to_process(changed_files)
methods.description: Determines which plugins need documentation regeneration based on changed files, categorizing the changes.

methods.name: generate_docs_for_plugin(plugin_name, file_types, logfile=None)
methods.description: Generates documentation for a specific plugin by invoking external scripts for headers and JSON outputs, with special handling for 'common' plugin.

methods.name: postprocess_md()
methods.description: Removes specific markup patterns from generated markdown files for cleanup.

methods.name: update_sidebar()
methods.description: Runs an external script to update the documentation sidebar after docs are generated.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main entry point that parses arguments, validates JSON changes, determines plugins to process, runs documentation generation, and performs post-processing and sidebar update.
